api_checks.description: POST /applications → 201 — document_checklist matches the pinned version's required-document list item for item
GET /applications/{application_id} → 200 — SUBMITTED, storing the policy_version_id resolved at submission
GET /applications/{application_id} → 200 — after a newer policy version is activated; stored policy_version_id and checklist are unchanged
GET /applications/{application_id} → 200 — every checklist item carries its document type and status PENDING
